meta.title: Cache hub_client.beta.threads.messages.list in environment.py
meta.body_summary: Implement an in-memory cache for thread message API calls in Environment class to avoid repeated network round-trips and reduce latency.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added in-memory cache for thread messages; maintainer reported 2-3s runtime reduction; merged with bot nits on cache copy and code duplication.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 63 changed lines in a single file, this is a small, focused performance improvement. It successfully merged after manual timing validation.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot pointed out that copying the full cache before slicing is wasteful and that cache-update logic in add_reply and _add_message is duplicated. No blocking comments; maintainers approved without requesting changes.
review_details.performance_claim: Caching eliminates repeated API calls; runtime reduced by 2-3 seconds in debug mode.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple in-memory caching within application logic is well within Copilot's capability; minor style/performance nits did not block merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot performed static analysis, noting cache copy inefficiency and code duplication; human reviewers approved without inline review comments.
detection_detail.manual_timing: arktoswb manually tested and reported a 2-3 second runtime reduction in debug mode.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No automated benchmark or profiler trace; maintainer provided informal timing.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR merged without further iteration.

core_change_summary.description: Added in-memory message cache to Environment class: cache populated on first _list_messages call, served from cache on subsequent calls, updated on add_reply and _add_message, and cleared at end of run.
change_trajectory: Initial plan commit, then single implementation commit with 60 additions and 3 deletions.

review_signals.summary: Posted PR Overview summarizing caching approach and suppressed low-confidence comments about missing tests, redundant flag, and cache copy inefficiency.
Cache-update logic duplicated in add_reply and _add_message; suggest extracting helper.
Copying entire cache before slicing wastes memory; suggest using itertools.islice to avoid extra copy.
Tested; runtime reduced by 2-3 seconds in debug mode.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR and implemented caching.
Copilot bot reviewed with minor performance/style suggestions.
arktoswb tested and confirmed timing improvement.
Two maintainers approved; merged ~19 hours after creation.
